description: A statically-false `required` on a note is refused too: present at all is the rule
expectedViolations: 'intro' is a `note`, which holds no value (Form IR §2.1), and it is marked `required`. Nothing can ever answer it, so this submission could never be finalised and the enumerator would be sent to a screen with nothing on it (Form IR §10.2, §6.2).
